uncertainties: The program never drives forward: in the dark with nothing close it does nothing, so it cannot get through a tunnel by itself, although you said it should get through the bend.
driveInTheDark, stopAtWall and followLine are in the program but never called, so their obstacle, light and line decisions never happen.
The light threshold is 70 %: under a tunnel's roof the robot only reacts from 7.5 cm inside the opening, and again in the last 7.5 cm before the exit it does what it does in the light.
The loop runs very fast, so one close wall can be seen again and again and the robot may turn several steps of 20° for one wall.
